Name: Pam Bundles
Author: veronicaab
Description:
Do you wish your community center was a little more...Pam? Then this is the mod for you! 

The new bundles focus on Pam, with a bit of Penny as well. It features bundles such as DIY Repair, Failed Brewer, Fishing Trip, and, of course, Pam's Bundle. 

Note: this mod replaces the standard bundles. It will not work if you select remixed bundles at setup.
